description: Hand-labelled plans with intended verdicts, written for JARVIS v5.5. Labels reflect the defect each plan contains, not the evaluator's output. Small and author-written: it measures regressions and relative improvement over the structural baseline, not general planning quality.

plan.goal: Fix the failing login test in the auth service

steps.description: Run the failing login test in the auth service to reproduce it
steps.completion_criteria: the login test fails with the reported assertion

steps.description: Inspect the auth service code path named in the failure log
steps.completion_criteria: root cause identified with file and line number

steps.description: Propose a fix for the login failure as a reviewable patch
steps.completion_criteria: patch diff limited to the auth module and reviewed

steps.description: Verify the fix: the login test passes and the suite has no new failures
steps.completion_criteria: login test passes and full suite shows no new failures
